slides.texte_overlay:
Things men only learn
after heartbreak
You can survive much more than you think. The first weeks feel endless. Then one morning you realise you laughed yesterday without thinking about it.
Your friends matter more than you knew. The ones who call, invite you out and listen without judging are the people to keep close forever.
You can't build your whole life around one person. Keep your own goals, hobbies and friendships, whatever relationship you're in next.
Silence is better than checking her profile. Every look reopens the wound. Giving yourself distance is the kindest thing you can do for both of you.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Filling your mind with new things helps you heal faster.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Filling your mind with new things helps you heal faster.

slides.texte_overlay: Your body is a great place to put the pain. Training, running, boxing. Every session clears your head and rebuilds your confidence.
It shapes the man you become. Heartbreak teaches you what you want, what you won't accept and how to love better next time.
